We burned the 10%, so the 9,000,000 $CARGO is a finite number of tokens that will ever exist. Cardano Gold has incorporated Satoshi’s initial vision with the emerging power of the Cardano blockchain. We are merging the two best crypto use cases: Store of Value and NFTs . Cardano Gold $CARGO did not have private sales, pre-sales, ISPOs, IDOs. Cardano Gold is a community-driven project.
